summary: Your app's paywall now looks like one people pay from, and you can test a real purchase before you ship.
notes: The paywall shows what Pro gives you, your plans as cards with "Save N%" when it's real, one Continue button, Close, and Manage subscription.
It matches your app's own colors, fonts and dark mode on iPhone and Android, and prices show the billing period and trial the stores require.
Test a purchase end to end with RevenueCat's Test Store in debug builds. Release builds never carry the test key.
Expo apps no longer crash on launch when the RevenueCat key is missing or wrong.
A wrong key, a failed purchase and a network problem each say what actually happened.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
